name: currency-webapp
description: Single-page React app where a signed-in User picks a source and target currency, enters an amount, and sees the converted result and rate. Talks only to currency-api; holds no exchange-rate credentials itself.

dependencies.name: currency-api
dependencies.description: Fetches the supported currency list and requests conversions.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs the user in via SSO before the converter is used.
